assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production base sprite for GLOMP!, a local 2D slime-and-food party game. The two input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, do not reproduce the banner or complete costumes. Generate ONE single isolated neutral white tintable jelly slime body, centered on a square transparent canvas, with generous equal transparent padding. Chibi glossy jelly slime, thick soft gray outline, cohesive with the reference images. Rounded squat gumdrop body, tiny integrated rounded feet, no separate arms. Pearly white grayscale body, bright soft white reflections and gentle neutral gray shading, no colored rim light, neutral lighting. Same simple silhouette usable for every player and cosmetic layer. Slight overhead three-quarter camera compatible with a top-down arena while keeping the front readable. BODY ONLY: no eyes, face, mouth, accessory, food, particles, detached droplets, ground shadow, scenery, lettering, watermark, grid, or other objects. Smooth clean silhouette and strong readability at 64 pixels. Actual transparent background.
